recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a glamorous woman in a patterned robe holding a mirror, juxtaposed with a vintage television set displaying a man's face, all framed by a slate-blue geometric border with magenta and gold accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome central imagery against a muted blue-grey geometric frame
The woman's profile gaze directed away from the television's direct stare
Circular clock-like graphic in the upper right balancing the rectangular TV screen
Horizontal text bars cutting across the verticality of the curtains and figures
coreInvariants: Desaturated, high-grain black and white photography for the subjects
Slate-blue matte border with sharp geometric cutouts
Magenta and gold as the primary accent colors for graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The woman occupies the left two-thirds of the frame; the television occupies the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's bright blonde hair and the glowing television screen act as dual focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the woman's face, follows her arm down to the TV, then moves up to the clock graphic in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark curtains and the solid blue-grey border to contain the busy photographic textures.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta (text bars and clock) and Gold (stamped text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the monochrome photography.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses ultra-wide, geometric sans-serif with thick strokes
Subtitle text uses a slanted, high-contrast serif with sharp terminals
Small metadata uses a condensed, blocky sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the display bar are spaced widely to fill the horizontal span
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, wide sans-serif and a delicate, slanted serif.
graphicDevices: Circular clock face with minimalist hands

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical feel of the display text
Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif used for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage featuring a black and white photo of a woman in a patterned robe looking into a mirror on the left, and a vintage TV showing a man's face on the right. Frame this with a matte slate-blue border containing geometric cutouts. Add a magenta circle with clock hands in the top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a dark blue horizontal bar in the top right with wide-spaced white sans-serif text. Add a magenta horizontal bar across the middle right with italicized serif text in dark blue.

verificationChecks: Are the horizontal bars perfectly aligned?
Is the letter spacing in the display text significantly wide?
Does the border have sharp, geometric corners?

adjustableVariables: Specific time shown on the clock graphic
mustRedesign: The exact faces of the individuals
The specific gold-stamped promotional text at the top

avoid: Soft or blurry edges on graphic elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the magenta bar overlaps both the photo and the border.
Check that the clock graphic uses a different color than the main border.
Verify the text is uppercase and widely tracked.
Confirm the TV screen has a visible scan-line or CRT texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast monochrome photography with a rigid, color-blocked geometric frame and wide-tracked technical typography to create a mid-80s synth-pop aesthetic.
